About.label: The studio
About.title: A small team, on purpose.
About.body_1: Infanina is a Singapore-registered software company. We work with businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets and shared inboxes, and want something built properly instead of patched again.
About.body_2: Every project runs with senior engineers on the keyboard. No layer of account managers between you and the build, no offshore handoff after the pitch, and no dependency on us once the work is done: the code, the accounts, and the deployment are yours from day one.

ownership.value: Singapore registered, Singapore owned. Your code and cloud accounts stay in your name.

team.value: The engineers you meet in the first call are the ones who write the code.

engagement.value: Fixed scope, weekly demos, and a working deployment from the first week.

stack.value: Boring, well-supported technology, chosen so another team could pick it up.

Capabilities.label: What we do
Capabilities.title: Three things, done properly.
Capabilities.lead: Most engagements are one of these. If yours is a mix, that is normal, and the first hour is where we work out the shape of it.

web.title: Web platforms
web.body: Customer portals, booking systems, internal tools, and the admin nobody wants to build. Fast, accessible, and structured so the second year of changes costs less than the first.

mobile.title: Mobile apps
mobile.body: iOS and Android from one codebase where that fits, native where it does not. We handle store submission, release management, and the parts that break offline.

ai.title: AI automation
ai.body: The daily manual work: reading documents, answering the same customer questions, moving data between systems that were never designed to talk. Built with a human in the loop for the decisions that matter.

Work.label: Selected work
Work.title: What a build looks like.
Work.lead: Four shapes of project we take on, described by scope and method rather than by numbers we cannot show you.
Work.reserved_note: Published once the client signs off
Work.disclosure: We publish a case study only after the client has reviewed it and agreed to the numbers in it. Until one clears that bar, these pages describe what we build and how we build it. Ask in the first call and we will walk you through work in progress directly.
Work.template_notice: This page describes a build we take on, not a delivered engagement. No client is named and no results are claimed.
Work.detail_cta_title: Tell us where the work is piling up.

operations_platform.title: Internal operations platform
operations_platform.summary: One place for the work currently spread across spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and one person's inbox.
operations_platform.problem: Operations run on files that get copied, renamed, and emailed. Nobody is certain which version is current, approvals happen verbally, and reporting means someone rebuilding the same sheet every month.
operations_platform.approach: We map the actual process first, including the shortcuts people take, then build the smallest system that replaces it without a training programme. Roles and permissions come early, because that is what makes a shared tool safe to use.
scope: Process mapping with the people who do the work
Web application with role-based access and an audit trail
Data migration from the current spreadsheets
Handover: source code, cloud accounts, and a written runbook

customer_mobile_app.title: Customer-facing mobile app
customer_mobile_app.summary: An app your customers keep on the first screen, released to both stores and maintainable after launch.
customer_mobile_app.problem: A mobile presence that is a wrapped website satisfies nobody. It is slow, it forgets you, and it stops working the moment the signal drops in a lift or a basement carpark.
customer_mobile_app.approach: We design for the moments the app is actually used, build offline-first so it survives bad signal, and set up releases so a fix reaches users in days rather than at the next big version.
scope: Product design covering the core journeys, not every screen
iOS and Android build with offline-first data sync
Push notifications and a release pipeline
Store submission for the App Store and Google Play

document_automation.title: Document processing automation
document_automation.summary: Invoices, forms, and claims read and filed automatically, with a person reviewing only what the system is unsure about.
document_automation.problem: Someone opens a PDF, types the numbers into another system, and files it. Repeat all day. It is slow, it introduces typos, and it is the first thing to fall behind when the team is busy.
document_automation.approach: We extract structure from the documents, attach a confidence score to every field, and route anything below your threshold to a review queue. The automation earns more responsibility as the numbers prove out, not on day one.
scope: Extraction pipeline for your document types
Confidence thresholds set with your team
Human review queue for anything uncertain
Integration into the system that already holds the data

messaging_assistant.title: Customer messaging assistant
messaging_assistant.summary: An assistant on WhatsApp that answers the routine questions and hands the rest to a person quickly.
messaging_assistant.problem: The same twenty questions arrive every day: opening hours, stock, order status, delivery. They arrive after hours too, and every one of them interrupts someone.
messaging_assistant.approach: The assistant answers only what it can answer from your real data, and escalates everything else with the full conversation attached. Escalation rules and tone are agreed before launch, and every conversation stays reviewable.
scope: WhatsApp Business API setup and verification
Answers grounded in your product and order data
Escalation to a human with the conversation attached
Conversation log and a weekly review of what it got wrong

Automation.label: AI automation
Automation.title: Same process. Fewer hands on it.
Automation.lead: We do not automate a department. We take one repeated process, remove the mechanical steps, and leave the judgement with your team.

steps.b2: Someone reads it and works out what it is
steps.b3: The details are retyped into another system
steps.b4: Someone checks it against a second source
steps.b5: A reply is written and sent
steps.a1: The document or message arrives and is classified
steps.a2: Details are extracted and checked against your data
steps.a3: Anything uncertain waits for your approval
steps.a4: The reply is drafted and sent on your rules

Automation.note: Every automated step is logged and reversible. If it cannot be reviewed, we do not automate it.

AboutPage.title: Built here, answerable here.
AboutPage.lead: A Singapore software studio for businesses that want the people building their systems to be reachable.
AboutPage.story_1: Infanina exists because of a pattern we kept seeing. A business commissions software, the agency that pitched it hands the work to someone else, and eighteen months later nobody can change anything without going back to a vendor who no longer remembers how it works.
AboutPage.story_2: So we built the studio around the opposite. Small team, senior engineers, one client conversation that runs from the first hour to the handover. We keep the number of active projects low enough that this stays true.
AboutPage.story_3: We are not the cheapest option and we are not trying to be the biggest. We are trying to be the team you call again.

scope.title: Scope before contract
scope.body: We do not quote before we understand the process. The free hour exists so both sides know what is being bought.

senior.title: Senior hands only
senior.body: The people in the first call write the code. No handoff to a team you have never met.

handover.title: You own everything
handover.body: Repositories, cloud accounts, domains, and documentation are in your name from the start. Leaving us should be easy.

week_zero.title: The free hour
week_zero.body: We map the process, agree what success looks like, and tell you the range. No slides, no obligation.

weekly.title: Weekly demos
weekly.body: Every week you see the real thing running, not a status report. Direction changes are cheapest here.

handover_step.title: Handover
handover_step.body: Source code, accounts, deployment steps, and a written runbook, walked through with whoever will hold it.

after.title: After launch
after.body: Optional support with a defined response time. Plenty of clients take the code and run it themselves, which is fine.

ServicesPage.title: What we build, and how it is priced.
ServicesPage.lead: Three disciplines and three ways to engage. Most projects start with the smallest one.
ServicesPage.engagements_title: Three ways to work with us.

sprint.title: Discovery sprint
sprint.body: For when the problem is clear but the solution is not. We map the process, prototype the hard part, and produce a scope and estimate you can take to anyone, including another studio.

build.title: Build
build.body: Design and engineering through to a live deployment, with weekly demos and a fixed scope agreed up front. Changes are handled as explicit trades, not as invoices that appear later.

care.title: Ongoing care
care.body: Hosting, monitoring, security updates, and an agreed number of change hours each month. For teams without an in-house engineer. Cancel with a month's notice and keep everything.

ServicesPage.pricing_note: We quote a range in the first hour and a fixed number after discovery. We do not bill by the hour for delivery work, because that prices you for our learning curve.

WorkPage.title: The work, described honestly.
WorkPage.lead: Four build shapes we take on. Client case studies appear here as they are approved for publication.
WorkPage.cta_title: Your project is not on this list.
WorkPage.cta_body: It rarely is. The first hour is where we work out which parts of it we have built before and which parts are new.

ContactPage.title: Let us hear the messy version.
ContactPage.lead: You do not need a specification. Tell us what happens today and who it slows down.

Privacy.title: Privacy policy
Privacy.lead: How Infanina collects, uses, and protects personal data, in line with Singapore's Personal Data Protection Act.

sections.title: Who we are
body: This policy applies to this website and to the services provided by Infanina, a company registered in Singapore. Our registered name, UEN, and address are printed in the footer of every page.
This policy is a template prepared for a Singapore-registered company. Have it reviewed by a qualified adviser, and confirm the details, before publishing.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you submit the contact form we collect the name, email address, company, phone number, and message you provide. Supplying a phone number is optional.

When you visit the site, our hosting provider records standard technical information such as IP address, browser type, and the pages requested. This is used for security and reliability, not for advertising profiles.
We do not use third-party advertising trackers, and we do not sell personal data.

sections.title: Why we use it
body: To respond to your enquiry and arrange the consultation you asked for.
To provide, support, and improve services under a contract with you or your organisation.
To meet legal, accounting, and regulatory obligations that apply to a Singapore company.

sections.title: Consent and withdrawal
body: By submitting the form you consent to us contacting you about your enquiry. You can withdraw that consent at any time by writing to the email address in the footer.
Withdrawing consent may mean we can no longer provide a service you have asked for. We will tell you clearly if that is the case.

sections.title: Disclosure to others
body: We share personal data only with service providers who help us operate, such as hosting, email, and error monitoring, and only to the extent they need it.
We may disclose data where required by law, or by a regulator with authority to demand it.
Some providers process data outside Singapore. Where that happens we take steps intended to ensure a standard of protection comparable to the Personal Data Protection Act.

sections.title: How long we keep it
body: Enquiries that do not become projects are deleted once they are no longer needed, and in any case within a reasonable period.
Records connected to a signed engagement are retained for as long as required by contract and by Singapore accounting and tax rules.

sections.title: Protection
body: We apply access controls, encryption in transit, and least-privilege practices to the systems that hold personal data.
No system is perfectly secure. If a data breach affects you and meets the notification threshold, we will notify you and the Personal Data Protection Commission as required.

sections.title: Your rights
body: You may request access to the personal data we hold about you, request correction of anything inaccurate, and ask how it has been used or disclosed.
Write to the email address in the footer. We will respond within the timeframe required by the Personal Data Protection Act.

sections.title: Cookies
body: This site uses only what is necessary to serve pages and remember your language choice. It does not set advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
If analytics are added later, this section will be updated before they are switched on.

sections.title: Contact and complaints
body: Questions about this policy, or about how your data has been handled, go to the email address in the footer.
If you are not satisfied with our response, you may raise the matter with the Personal Data Protection Commission of Singapore.
